CA.rationale: Content label and an explicit processing/origin condition are stated for the same candidate item.

COD.rationale: The item has an identified content (red), an explicit origin/organization marker (inherited_current), and the content is listed separately from its origin/status.

A.rationale: An explicit processing/origin change (inherited_current) is linked to the same identified candidate content.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content labels (red/blue) with coordinate-valued attributes are listed.

D.rationale: The report gives content identity (coordinates) and separately attributes an origin/status for the same item.

O.rationale: The text states presentation orientation and explicit origin/organization markers for items.
